content.title: Full WrestleMania 42 Saturday highlights
content.text: 1,092,143 views • Apr 18, 2026 Witness all the highlights from WrestleMania 42 Saturday, featuring Cody Rhodes, Randy Orton, Liv Morgan, AJ Lee and more. Catch WWE action on ESPN, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock and more. Where to watch WWE: https://wwe.com/wheretowatch …...more ...more Men's White Roman Reigns Tribal Logo T-Shirt Size: 2XL Shop for your favorite Men's Roman Reigns gear at the WWE Shop! When the Tribal Chief chooses to grace an arena with his presence, one has no choice but to acknowledge him. Point your one to the sky and recognize that greatness stands before you by making this Tribal Logo T-Shirt yours. Featuring stylized Superstar graphics across the chest and back neck, this cotton tee perfectly embodies the Mafia boss-like power the Head of the Table has over his Samoan Bloodline and the roster at large. Don this adrenaline-filled tee and let the whole WWE Universe know you're standing strong with the man who built the empire from the ground up. CM Punk Replica Side Plate Box Set Shop for your favorite CM Punk gear at the WWE Shop! Perfect for displaying your love for The Best In The World, this CM Punk Replica Side Plate box set offers a fitting homage. Place them in your replica Championship title or let them stand alone and commemorate CM Punk's ascension to the ranks of sports entertainment elite who've proudly hoisted the gold. Men's Blue Randy Orton RKO Everybody T-Shirt Size: Large Shop for your Large Men's Randy Orton gear at the WWE Shop! Strike quick with an RKO outta nowhere! Show your love for The Viper by snagging this Randy Orton RKO Everybody T-Shirt. As a 14-time World Champion and one of the most naturally gifted Superstars in sports entertainment history, Randy Orton has delivered countless memorable moments, and this tee lets the whole WWE Universe know you hear those same voices in your head. The stylized Superstar graphics printed across the front embody Orton's intensity and will have you ready to see him unleash those three most deadly letters at any moment. Undisputed WWE Championship Replica Title Belt Shop for your favorite WWE Merchandise gear at the WWE Shop! The Undisputed WWE Championship represents the champion of all champions and the ultimate prize in sports entertainment. Now, you can go for the gold by adding this prestigious Undisputed WWE Championship Replica Title Belt title to your collection. Revealed to the world on June 2, 2023, during SmackDown, this championship belt is a must-have for any WWE fan and title collector. Men's Black Stephanie Vaquer La Primera T-Shirt Size: 5XL Shop for your favorite Men's Stephanie Vaquer gear at the WWE Shop! The time has arrived to celebrate the arrival of La Primera at the top of the Women's division! Show your support for The Dark Angel and reigning Women's World Champion by grabbing this Stephanie Vaquer La Primera T-Shirt. The tee features a devilish image of the Chilean Superstar printed across the chest and back. With a comfortable crew neck and a 100% cotton design, this tee is the perfect way to show your support for one of the WWE's deadliest competitors. Men's White Cody Rhodes Stars & Stripes Nightmare T-Shirt Size: 2XL Shop for your favorite Men's Cody Rhodes gear at the WWE Shop! Feel the adrenaline in your soul and prepare to shout "WOAH OHHH!" as if Cody Rhodes's pyro is about to burst whenever you sport this sweet Stars & Stripes Nightmare T-Shirt. Featuring a stylized version of his patriotic, hard-edged graphic, this tee is sure to take your WWE wardrobe from unremarkable to undeniable. Grab this tee before heading to the next premium live event and be ready to go wild for a Cross Rhodes and the 1-2-3!
